calculation_handling.description: On a through lot, any lot line separating the lot from a street may be selected as the front lot line if it is not separated from the street by a 0.3 metre reserve.
calculation_handling.gaps: The tool does not hold street reserve data.

calculation_handling.description: On a through lot, any lot line separating the lot from a street may be selected as the front lot line if it abuts a street where an adjacent lot has its front lot line on the same street.
calculation_handling.gaps: The tool does not hold which street each adjacent lot fronts.

calculation_handling.description: For a lot with a townhouse or apartment building that abuts a major street, the front lot line is the lot line abutting the major street, overriding the choice in (A) and (B).
calculation_handling.gaps: The tool does not hold which lot lines abut a major street.

calculation_handling.description: A residential building may not be erected on a lot without a front lot line of at least 3.5 metres, unless the lot abuts a lane with a minimum width of 6.0 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: No modelled target for the length of the front lot line or the width of a lane.

units.disclosure: A residential building cannot be built on a lot whose front lot line is under 3.5 metres, unless the lot abuts a lane at least 6.0 metres wide and meets the rear lot line condition. The tool does not evaluate this test.

calculation_handling.description: The exception to the 3.5 metre front lot line minimum also requires at least 3.5 metres of the rear lot line to abut the lane.
calculation_handling.gaps: No modelled target for the length of lot line abutting a lane.

units.disclosure: The exception for a lot with a short front lot line also requires at least 3.5 metres of the rear lot line to abut the lane. The tool does not evaluate this test.

10.5.30.20(1).explanation: On a through lot, either street frontage may be chosen as the front lot line if it has no 0.3 metre reserve and the street is one where an adjacent lot fronts. A townhouse or apartment lot abutting a major street must use the major street as its front lot line.

10.5.30.20(2).explanation: A residential building needs a front lot line of at least 3.5 metres, unless the lot abuts a lane at least 6.0 metres wide and has at least 3.5 metres of its rear lot line on that lane.
